hypotheses.title: News Sentiment Ternary Volume Surge with 10-Day Smoothing for Turnover Suppression
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In the user's verified 8-PASS alpha, 60-day accumulated after-hours news sentiment (nws12_afterhsz_sl) creates a high-Sharpe (1.87) regime selector, while 5-day volume acceleration relative to the 252-day baseline isolates liquid institutional accumulation. That baseline achieved Sharpe 1.87, Turnover 9.84%, and Fitness 1.16 with self-correlation of only 0.2632. However, the 5-day volume mean generates minor daily turnover churn. By smoothing the short-term volume numerator to 10 days (ts_mean(volume, 10)), daily rebalancing noise is cut by ~35-40%, projecting turnover to drop from 9.84% to ~5.5-6.5%. Because Fitness = Sharpe * sqrt(Returns / Turnover), lowering turnover to 6% while preserving the 1.87 Sharpe and ~3.8% return directly elevates Fitness from 1.16 past 1.50, achieving the official BRAIN 'GOOD' tier.
confounders: Sudden broader market liquidity contractions that distort volume across all equity deciles
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 10-day volume smoothing increases turnover > 10% or reduces Sharpe < 1.25 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Refinement of user's 8-PASS news alpha using 10-day volume smoothing to suppress turnover to 5-6% and propel Fitness past 1.50.

hypotheses.title: Symmetric Directional News-Volume Confirmation Engine
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In the user's baseline formula, the volume surge term power(rank(...), 0.5) is added to both positive news stocks (weight 1 to 2) and negative news stocks (weight 0 to 1). In subindustry-neutral portfolios, this forces the short leg to short low-volume stocks rather than high-volume stocks with negative news. When heavy institutional distribution hits negative-news equities, high trading volume signals aggressive liquidation. By converting the ternary condition into a symmetric directional boost (+1 + V^0.5 for positive news, and -1 - V^0.5 for negative news), high volume aggressively accelerates short conviction on bad news names while low-volume churn is suppressed. This substantially widens the return spread between long and short buckets, increasing Annualized Return toward 6-7% and lifting Fitness past 1.50.
confounders: High-volume short squeezes on heavily shorted negative-sentiment equities
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if symmetric directional volume confirmation yields Fitness < 1.50 or Sharpe < 1.25 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Symmetric directional volume confirmation rewarding high volume on positive news and heavily penalizing high volume on negative news.

hypotheses.title: Operational Cashflow Efficiency Derivative Ternary Volume Engine
hypotheses.economic_rationale: To satisfy the strict requirement for two distinct qualifying alphas from orthogonal datasets with self-correlation < 0.35, Candidate 3 ports the user's verified Ternary Volume Surge architecture into model16 cashflow derivatives. cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative ranks equities continuously by operational profitability and cash generation (100% matrix coverage in TOP3000, zero concentration risk, zero sell-side analyst overlap). Accumulating this operational quality metric over 60 days (ts_sum(cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative, 60)) creates a stable fundamental quality regime filter with negligible turnover. Coupling it with the 10-day volume surge engine provides sharp daily cross-sectional stock selection, targeting Sharpe > 1.60, Turnover < 10%, and Fitness > 1.50.
confounders: Lagged quarterly filing disclosures during regime-shifting macroeconomic inflections
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if model16 cashflow ternary volume engine yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 1.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Orthogonal model16 cashflow quality regime engine driven by 10-day volume surge, designed for self-correlation < 0.20 and Fitness > 1.50.
